title: Register ZKDisputeGame at gameType=10
summary: Deploy a ZK dispute game implementation (with a mock verifier) and register it on the L1 DisputeGameFactory, signed by the factory owner.
audience: OP Stack contributors prototyping the ZK dispute game migration on a local L1.
description:
## Why this exists

The canonical FDG → ZK upgrade goes through OPCM: governance multisigs delegatecall into `OPContractsManagerV2.upgrade()`, which bundles dispute factory registration with portal/system-config upgrades.

**OPCM is not deployed by the Minimal preset.** This script bypasses OPCM and calls the factory directly — the same end state, but skipping the governance plumbing.

## What ships

- A fresh `ZKMockVerifier` (always-passes, from `test/dispute/zk/`)
- A fresh `ZKDisputeGame` impl (real source from `src/dispute/zk/`)
- The 172-byte CWIA gameArgs encoding the verifier, durations, bond, anchor registry, delayed WETH, and L2 chain id.

## What it does NOT do

Registration alone does not flip consensus — the AnchorStateRegistry's *respected* game type still points at PERMISSIONED_CANNON. Run `switch-to-zk-consensus` next to actually finalize via ZK.
